Siripalli Venkata Kalyan

Full Stack Developer

9912351526 ◇ siripallivenkatakalyan@gmail.com ◇ Hyderabad, India ◇ linkedin.com/in/kalyansiripalli

SUMMARY

IIT Dhanbad graduate with 2.5+ years of full stack development experience, specialising in React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and FastAPI. Proven expertise in building scalable enterprise SaaS and healthcare applications, covering API design, UI state management, and backend security (JWT, RBAC). Strong proficiency in frontend development, database schema design, and query optimisation. Available to join immediately.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages C, C++, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, SQL Frontend React.js, Redux, Zustand, React Router, Tailwind CSS, Micro-frontends, Responsive Design, HTML, CSS Backend Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, RESTful API Design, JWT, RBAC, Microservices Databases MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL Tools & Platforms Git, GitHub, Docker, Jenkins, Postman, Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code

EXPERIENCE

Full Stack Developer AidenAI

Sep '24 — Jul '26 Hyderabad, Telangana

Engineered a modular, full stack enterprise workforce management tool, streamlining operations for a 400+ person workforce by centralizing accounts, project estimates, and resource allocation. Implemented centralized single sign-on (SSO) and Casbin-based Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), securing multitenant access across 10+ configurable user roles. Architected a scalable micro-frontend and microservices foundation using module federation, decoupling 6 independent domains and eliminating inter-team deployment conflicts. Built a Natural Language-to-Unqork JSON generator, reducing manual workflow configuration effort by approximately 85%. Developed a dependency visualizer and JSON diff utility in React.js, enabling teams to detect cross-version configuration regressions in real time—reducing regression debugging time by 50%.

Full Stack Developer Intern HexaHealth

Jul '23 — Jan '24 Gurugram, Haryana

Architected an end-to-end internal dashboard for the dietetics team using the MERN stack, enabling the tracking of patient weight-loss journeys across 100+ patients and replacing manual reporting. Engineered RESTful APIs for user interaction analytics and surgical cost calculation, handling 10,000+ monthly requests with structured error handling and reliable data processing. Optimized database schemas and created stored procedures to integrate 19,000+ insurance slugs into the sitemap, significantly improving SEO coverage and discoverability.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in MME, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) - Dhanbad

Jul '19 — May '23 Jharkhand, India

PROJECTS

NetflixGPT Link

Built a full stack movie recommendation app in React.js, integrating OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo to generate personalised suggestions from natural language queries against the TMDB API. Integrated secure authentication and session management using Google Firebase, leveraging Redux slices to synchronize user login state and maintain consistent application state.

DineDash Link

Designed DineDash, a food delivery web application with a Swiggy-inspired UI, implementing API-driven restaurant listings and modular, reusable React components. Developed backend services with RESTful APIs, implementing CORS middleware and structured error handling to ensure stable and secure frontend-backend integration. Delivered key UX features including centralized cart management, auto-suggestion search, and location-based listings, significantly improving application interactivity.

AWARDS

Letter of Recommendation Vice President of Technology - HexaHealth
